records.bodyText: {"model":"gpt-5.2","instructions":"You are Mixdog native web search.\nUse the hosted web_search tool for current or external facts.\nAnswer concisely, cite source URLs, and do not request local tools or file edits.","input":[{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"find x"}]}],"tools":[{"type":"web_search","search_context_size":"medium","filters":{"allowed_domains":["a.com","b.com"]}}],"tool_choice":"required","parallel_tool_calls":true,"reasoning":{"effort":"medium","summary":"auto"},"store":true,"stream":true,"include":["reasoning.encrypted_content","web_search_call.action.sources"],"prompt_cache_key":"mixdog-openai-e04514af7416f72d7e","text":{"verbosity":"low"},"prompt_cache_retention":"24h"}

cryptoRandom.seedDerivation: one stream per product call site: fnv1a32(scenarioId) ^ fnv1a32(site) ^ 0x9e3779b9
cryptoRandom.note: only calls with a product frame on the stack; temp-file/lock names from shared/file-lock.mjs and shared/atomic-file.mjs are omitted (background cache writers, a race with the scenario window)

determinism.notRecorded: the local agent-trace flush timers (fire-and-forget; their presence in a scenario window is a race), delays of watchdog/deadline timers, timers created by Node internals (undici, ws, AbortSignal.timeout), and any wall-clock value
